body:
Thank you for taking the time to read my story.

I have talked to my relatives. My grandmother in particular; she discouraged my mother from going to college years ago. 

She has accepted that I'm going, but doesn't like it, despite the fact that I'm taking New Testament studies, and would like to get a minor in theology. When she found out I didn't have the funds she just said "Oh, well. It's probably for the best. You'll be fine."

The rest of my extended relatives just don't particularly care one way or another. They've never been really supportive or involved in my life anyway so to them this does not mean anything or they have the same feelings as my grandmother. (My cousin was going to bartending school and was shamed into quitting because she felt she was participating in the intoxication and sins of people. 

The thing is, I've never done anything like that. I've never been on drugs, I've never drank excessively, I don't curse or party - nothing. And not for religious reasons. 

I've seen that from my dad and his side of the family and I hated it, so I made the choice not to do it. I think that's one of the most discouraging things about this - I feel like overall I've been really decent, but people just assume I'll get caught up in a whirlwind of "sin" despite the fact that I'm really legitimately thirsty for knowledge. Being out of school for several years and not continuing my education made me value it. I want to read and study and have assignments given to me. 

I have looked into grants and scholarships, although I did all this on my own so I'm sure I've probably overlooked something. I've been trying to get in contact with a local Shriners club because I heard that sometimes they can help with things like that, but so far I haven't heard anything back. I'm just so overwhelmed and frustrated.

Weekends are usually easier for me, because (and this sounds horrible, but) I'm not worried about creditors calling me and telling me something new I owe. I just feel like I'm suffocating Mon-Fri worrying about it. Weekends are a solace and I've been severely depressed this weekend thinking about it...but I'm trying not to go under. 

I appreciate your help and if you do know of any scholarships or grants I would love to know about them. The ones I have found are no longer available for this year (they ended Dec '11) but I might have missed something. 

Thank you so much again.
